attributes.decisive_finding: The residual is a SINGLE UNRESERVED 4-BYTE HOLE in the compiler-temp group, not a register web and not a declaration-order error. Measured layout, frame 920 on both sides: TARGET places flag=784, keydata-param home=792, int-to-double magic high word=796, leaving 788 EMPTY; OURS packs them flag=784, keydata=788, magic=792 with no hole. Reading the target at +0x638..+0x670 confirms the roles (`li r0,-1 / stw r0,784` and `li r0,0 / stw r0,784` are the flag; `lis r0,17200 / stw r0,796` is the int-to-double magic). Because PROBE3 and PROBE4 moved all three slots together from two different declaration positions, function-scope declaration order CANNOT open a hole inside that group: MWCC assigns these three as a contiguous compiler-temp block above the named locals and slides the whole block when named storage changes. The 4 bytes at 788 must therefore be a compiler temp or inner-block local that retail's source materialised and our reconstruction does not - which is the same class of endgame the sDvdReadSync record names ('the next lever must be the compiler-temp reservation or an unrecovered inner-block local').
